svg.text: RECON • DETECT • ALERT • OPTICS — v0.63.1 • Slow-Hardware Tuned PWA + Python OpenCV & Android MediaCodec Gateways

g.text: • UVC USB: getUserMedia + Android libuvc bridge
• TCP_NODELAY + Android fast NV21 UV copy
• Clean View Declutter + Full Keyboard Mapping
• Safe profile import + persisted Micro slot bindings
• Strictly bypassed unless enabled in Controllers
• Synced Live, Playback & Hits swipe/key bindings
• Synced Hits/Reticle toggles across all screens
• Frame-deduped USB blits; rAF sleeps when hidden/off-Live
• Zero-flicker Hit Pins, adaptive timestamps & PNG snapshot
• 160×90 luma grid (Float64Array) • >18% Shake Gate • 5% Max Area
• 1-Tap ✦ Auto-Tune (1.3s live noise sample) + Ignore Zones
• 14,400-cell thermal debug putImageData runs only on Calibration
• 1.5x–12.0x movable/resizable PiP window + draggable ROI crosshair
• Loupe AA snaps ROI to latest hit automatically
• Lazy-decoded on first voice enable (saves 19–38 MB RAM on boot)
• Cycles OFF → POI ("Point of Impact") → POA ("Point of Aim")
• Speaks Cartesian clicks ("2 left, 3 up") & clock bearings
• Generation cancel tokens + pitch-adjusted timing (zero overlap)
• Automatic local Web Speech API fallback
• First Focal Plane (FFP): Subtensions scale 1:1 with digital zoom
• 4 Center Styles: Empty, Dot, Cross, Chevron • 2–30 Clicks/Arm
• 6 Unified Tactical Themes + Custom Picker (WCAG contrast)
• Synced Reticle ON/OFF across Live, Playback, Hits & Studio
• Interactive click-to-test voice callouts on 4 scene backdrops
• Translucent glass UI + Clean View declutter mode
• Custom PNG/SVG reticle persists across restarts (<= 1 MB)
3. RAM RING BUFFER, ARCHIVE & OFFLINE PWA
• Rolling 5–60s @ 5–30 FPS JPEG queue (zero disk I/O)
• Device-aware RAM cap (<= 220 MB on 4 GB tablets)
• Captures strictly on Live; pauses on all other screens
• Generation-safe reset prevents async toBlob races
• Opens LIVE BUFFER unsaved (no auto-save clutter)
• GPU scaleX() RAM Meter (updates only when open)
• Freed immediately upon leaving Screen 2 Archive
• Single stage: 0.5x Slow-Mo, -1/+1 step, numbered hit scrubber
• Save Clip to IndexedDB + .webm / annotated PNG export
• File picker requested BEFORE MediaRecorder encode
• Corrupt-JPEG safe LRU ImageBitmap frame decoder
• Pins: SYNC (with video) / ALL / OFF + unified drawer
• Older hits outside buffer load saved clip or still snapshot
• Top-right Reticle, Pins, 🕒, Re-Zero, Clear & Save
• Playback rAF stops cleanly when paused or on still view
• Pre-caches all 40 core assets; bypasses cross-origin IPs
• Android 10+: Binds camera Wi-Fi AP even with LTE active
• Windows: Localhost default (--lan opt-in for iOS/iPad)
• Strict rtsp:// + private-IP wake SSRF protection
• 100% local processing — zero telemetry or cloud calls
